source: calculators/defaults.py, prices.py, issuance.py (generated by python -m calculators.export; do not edit)

om.source: R/CEA CO2 Baseline Database v22.0 (FY2025-26): Results sheet 'incl. Imports' column = User Guide v22 Table S – simple operating margin

bm.source: R/CEA CO2 Baseline Database v22.0 (FY2025-26): Results sheet 'incl. Imports' column = User Guide v22 Table S – build margin (20% most recent generation, incl. RE)

cm_published.source: R/CEA CO2 Baseline Database v22.0 (FY2025-26): Results sheet 'incl. Imports' column = User Guide v22 Table S – published combined margin (50:50 OM/BM)

weighted_avg.source: R/CEA CO2 Baseline Database v22.0 (FY2025-26): Results sheet 'incl. Imports' column = User Guide v22 Table S – weighted average incl. RES and captive

data_central_year.source: Central year r of the BM reference period (AMT-007 Eq. 12): BM units in R/CEA v22 Data sheet were commissioned Jul 2019-Mar 2026, generation-weighted mean 2022.6 (RE added in aggregate, more recent); 2023 used

re_nuclear_share.source: Hydro + nuclear + RE share of total net generation FY2025-26 from R/CEA v22 Results sheet (24.3% in 2023-24, 26.1% in 2024-25). Below AMT-007 Table 4's 30% limit, so simple OM is usable for case 2 - likely to exceed 30% from FY2026-27

CCTS.source: M/BM_EN01.001 v1.0 §4.5 Eq. 11 & para 66: EFgrid,CM as published by CEA

Verra.source: T/VT0011 v1.0 para 86 Case 1 (first crediting period): wind & solar 0.50/0.50; all other projects supplying or saving grid electricity 0.40/0.60. VMR0017 v1.0 §2 requires VT0011. VT0011 Step 5 also changes the BM sample; CEA BM used as is

PACM.source: T/A6.4-AMT-007 v02.0 Table 5 (case 2 = baseline, lower EF is conservative, so lowest wOM), Eq. 12 BM vintage decay, Appendix 2 India: FOM,simple 0.06%, FBM 15.70%/yr. Simple OM for case 2 needs RE+nuclear share <=30% (Table 4): India 29.9% in FY2025-26, see GRID re_nuclear_share

GoldStandard.source: T/A6.4-AMT-007 v02.0 as for PACM, modified by T/GS PAA MT400-10 v1.0 §5.2: decay factor capped at 5%/yr and elapsed years reduced by 2 (floor 0)

PACM_DA.source: M/A6.4-AMM-003 v01.0 §7.3: DAinitial = max(0.1, uncertainty) (Eq. 4-5), INDA 0.01/yr (para 52); M/A6.4-AMM-001 Eq. 34 same 1%/yr. Uncertainty-based DA can exceed 10% (not modelled)

GS_DAF_INDIA.source: T/GS PAA MT400-05 v1.0 Table 3: India DAF 2.04% (Tier 3, net zero 2070 in law), fixed for 2026-2030, BEadj = BE x (1 - DAF) (eq. 3). Not used for PACM methodologies applied under GS (§4.1.2b): those keep the PACM downward adjustment

CUF.source: Demo assumption; replace with project DPR / P50 yield

GWP_CH4.source: AR5 GWP100: E/VCS Standard v5.0 §3.14.4 & Table 9; M/AWMS v2.0 param BGTA 21; T/A6.4-AMT-004 (IPCC AR5). BEE methodologies give no value

FUELS.source: T/IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch 1 Tables 1.2 & 1.4 (defaults; biomass EF 0 as renewable). M/AMS-II.D v13 & BM IN02.001 allow IPCC defaults when no local data
FUELS.note: Indian coal NCV is often well below IPCC bituminous (IPCC range 19.9-30.5); ask for measured NCV

F.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param F

DOCf.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param DOCf,default

MCF.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param MCF (application A)

OX.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param OX

DOC.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param DOCj

k.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param kj (tropical: MAT > 20C; wet: MAP > 1000 mm)

composition.source: Demo placeholder for Indian MSW; replace with municipal waste characterisation

phi.source: T/TOOL04 v8.1 (same in T/A6.4-AMT-003 v01.0) param φdefault: Application A (LFG capture, e.g. ACM0001) = 0.75 wet and dry

collection_eff.source: Central 50% = project capture efficiency assumed in M/ACM0001 v19 fn 4 and M/A6.4-AMM-001 fn 12; range is a demo assumption

destruction_eff.source: T/A6.4-AMT-004 v01.0 §5.2: enclosed default 90%, open 50% (same in T/TOOL06 v1; repo has v1, active CDM version is v4.0). Engine treated like enclosed flare

mwh_per_t_ch4.source: 50 MJ/kg CH4 LHV x 35% engine efficiency (assumption)

animals.source: T/IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 4 Ch 10 Table 10.13A (VS, India subcontinent), Table 10A.5 (TAM), Table 10.16A (B0, other regions). Low productivity is the Tier 1 default outside NA/Europe/Oceania (10.16A fn 1). Required by M/AMS-III.D v22, ACM0010, BM AG04.001

mcf_baseline.source: T/IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 4 Ch 10 Table 10.17 (Updated), warm/tropical columns

digester_leakage.source: M/BM_AG04.001 v1.0 para 15 Eq. 3: 10% of max methane potential (IPCC 10.17 gives 1-13% by digester quality)

uf_b.source: Net-to-gross uncertainty factor: M/AMS-III.D v22, BM AG04.001 v1.0, AWMS v2.0 (all 0.89)

m3_ch4_to_t.source: M/BM_AG04.001 Eq. 2: 0.67 kg CH4 per m3

capture_fraction_of_b0.source: Share of B0 a digester realises as usable gas (assumption)

agb_increment_t_dm.source: T/IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 4 Ch 4 Table 4.10 (Updated), Asia rows. Teak has an Asia value only in mountain systems; elsewhere it uses 'other'

root_shoot.source: T/IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 4 Ch 4 Table 4.4 (Updated), Asia, AGB <= 125 t/ha (rainforest: planted). No Asia value for tropical shrubland; tropical dry used

carbon_fraction.source: IPCC 2006 Vol 4 Table 4.3, tropical/subtropical 0.47; not refined in 2019 (T/IPCC 2019 Refinement Vol 4 Ch 4 p. 4.17)

stocking.source: Survival x stocking vs IPCC plantation (assumption)

uncertainty.source: M/VM0047 v1.1 §8.7(3): minimum 10% ex-ante uncertainty deduction

buffer.source: T/VCS AFOLU NPRT v4.2 §2.5.2: minimum risk rating 12 (= 12% buffer), above 60 fails (§2.5.3). 15% and 25% are demo assumptions
